075-F · Parity audit: the old town against now

Vela, 2026-10-28. Sky: "the surrounding buildings, plants, etc all need to be more like the old town". The plan, the generator and the civic block stay; the old DecoKit town is the acceptance test for everything around it, and the 2.5D testbed café and district office set the finish standard. Each row puts the old town (and the testbed where it applies) beside now, says what the old had and the rule it was placed by (from the old Editor/DecoKit code), the counts, the gap, the owner and a rough size.

Sources. Old: the reel stills (briefs/074/flyby/old-stills) and seven new play-zoom renders from the old copy (DecoKitIso: ortho 14–17 at 38°, yaw 45; out/scratch/vela075/old-iso); counts from DecoKitStreet.unity (11,423 prefab instances, by source guid). Now: the 075 flyby grid, 075 shots, the 10-27 play batch; counts from out/world/harbour-district.world.json (13:54 today, with 075-E partly landed). Testbed: briefs/026 and 028 captures of ~/Projects/the-suborned/testbed. Analysis reused: designs.md (Splice), textures.md, grade.md. Old counts cover a smaller dressed area (a 420 m boulevard, Southside and the harbour) than our district, so read them as density, not totals. Click any image to enlarge it; hover for its source file.

StreamBay/End/Corner _3/_4/_6/_9/_9W, DecoBay_10, Porthole and Balcony bays for rhythm. One family per street wall (DecoKitColourways ensemble), one coral fascia ribbon down both sides. The export counted here (13:54) already carries the first 1,744 StreamBayStack modules.

Billboards, posters, signage missingowner: Splice (rules BB-1..4), Datum (plan keys), Vela (poster art sheets) · size M

What the old town had, and how it was placed

Hand-placed in DistrictDressing, but on readable rules: rooftop boards on the low roofs next to taller walls (civic hall 11 m, crescents 26.5 m, back bays 36.7 m), turned to the vista or to the walk; wall boards 8 m up, stacked on the crescent's first three chords; pylon boards flanking the parade vista at ±17 m and on the quay; ad columns at kerb + 3 m at the four circus mouths; blade signs at 4.6 m (clear of the 3.85–4.0 m canopies) on cafés, hotel and cinema; neon stars; a cinema marquee.

Gap

The whole layer is missing even though every piece is adopted. No rule names billboard:*; sign-frame draws an empty frame; the ad column loses its corner roll. Proposed rules: BB-1 sign-frame roofs take Billboard_Rooftop, turned to the longest street axis or vista they see; BB-2 wall boards on blank party walls above a lower neighbour (today those faces get SideBayStack); BB-3 pylon boards at quays, plaza mouths and vista pairs; BB-4 ad columns at junction mouths, blade signs on café/hotel/cinema trades at 4.6 m. Poster art: the old board textures, plus new sheets in the §15 voice (no text in play beyond brand words).

Question for Sky: Do rooftop boards (6–8 m above the roof) count against the play-street height cap (16.8–20.4 m)? The old placed them on the low roofs exactly where the cap applies.

What the old town had, and how it was placed

One tram lane at x −2.5 in the carriageway: Tile_TramRail every 2 m (rails in setts, in the road surface). A 2 m stop island between the tram lane and the west lane with half-round granite noses (Kerb_GraniteNose) and two TramCanopy; a BusShelter and TicketMachine on the pavement end; the tram terminates 6 m short of the circus; one Tram car parked at the stop. No overhead wire: atomic trams need none (don't add a catenary).

The routes and stops are better than the old (real lines, 20 stops). What is missing is the track itself and the car: the line reads as two concrete paths in a lawn. Port: export the track as Tile_TramRail refs (powder-blue road texture around steel rails), a paved or sett track bed where it runs in a median, the Tram car parked at a stop per line (moving in 075-D).

DecoKitSkyRail: a closed loop 24 m up, 13 m off the boulevard axis over the west promenade, circling the sphere station at 34 m (R 88); a harbour line on a balloon loop R 48 at 24 m round the skyport. Beam: a 1.2 × 1.6 m filleted section (0.22 m radius) swept at 2 m steps, ivory DK_Enamel_Ivory with a proud teal stripe each side, UV along the line. Pylons every 30 m (nudged off blocks and pavements), kit SkyRail_Pylon_Tall + stretched Shaft + Head, never in the road or the circus ring. Two three-car streamliners per line at 22 m/s.

The routes stay (plan data). The look is the gap: flat coral bars read as a diagram line in every aerial, and the pylon kit and cars are still candidates. Port: one swept filleted beam (or the twin-track head the old carried one beam on), the stripe, kit pylons at 30 m from the export, the cars parked at stations (moving in 075-D).

Question for Sky: Sky rail colour: coral (GDD §01 "coral transit") or the old ivory with a stripe? Proposal: ivory beam with a coral stripe, so transit still reads coral.

What the old town had, and how it was placed

CoconutPalm in 2 m pits every 10 m, the west side 6 m off the east (staggered), random yaw, no LOD. Frontage strip (StreetLife): urns flanking bays 1, 5, 9… of each run of bays, a trough under bays 3, 7…, topiary at each run end; hanging baskets every 6 m over café terraces; ferns at terrace ends; cypress and fan palms in squares and gardens; flower beds and shrub mounds on greens.

Gap

Same palm FBX, already close to the kerb. "Lush" is the spacing (12 against 10), pairs instead of a stagger, the wider street, and the missing frontage greenery: the old urn/trough/topiary rhythm on every run of bays is absent, and the testbed's flowering beds round the civic block are clipped hedges here. Port: FR-1 (the old frontage rule, keyed to our bays), more cypress at corners, flower beds from the testbed palette.

Question for Sky: Palms at 10 m staggered? It reverses the 2026-10-22 call for 12 m (crowns roof 60 % of the kerb line, not 50 %).

DistrictLife / SouthsideLife / Citizens: cars down both carriageways, along Market Street and round the circus ring, a car every gap where nothing stands, parked against the kerb in most pit gaps; five RetroFutureMobility bodies (bubble micro, family wagon, delivery van, taxi, shuttle) each tinted from the ensemble palette. The single biggest "empty" read in every view. Two separate jobs: (1) presentation (flyby, menus): 075-D, static or moving cars, aircars and trains, no sim impact; (2) play: life.json already has traffic rules (lanes, mix car/hover-car/van, flow), but ambient traffic in play is a simulation change (determinism, sight lines, the getaway). The RFM bodies are ~22k tris, over the crowd-tier budget: Forma would rebuild them to budget.

Rooftops (tanks, masts, signs) partialowner: Splice (roof plots + theme weights, RF-1 no repeat), Vela (adopt Bandstand, Radome, Drum, Dish; terrazzo deck) · size M

What the old town had, and how it was placed

Roofline + RoofThemes: "from the 2.5D camera a roof is half of every building", so every roof on the district's walls is programmed. Each building's 14 m roof strip splits at bay joints into plots of 12–30 m; each plot takes a weighted theme unlike the plot before it, on a terrazzo deck: lido (lap pool, cabanas, palms; w 2), tennis (1.5), garden (lawn, bandstand, palms, benches; 2), café (kiosk, cabanas, tulip sets; 2), glass (conservatory, planters; 1.5), machine (radome, dish, tank, drum, lattice mast 35 %; 1.5), sun deck (deckchairs, troughs; 1). Plots under a tower or carrying a board or pad get only planters.

Gap

The play camera sees roofs more than facades. Ours is two thirds plant (masts and spheres), one theme per whole roof, so the roofscape reads white and spiky where the old read turquoise pools, green lawns and coral cabanas. Port: split roofs into plots at bay joints, the old weights and the no-repeat rule, terrazzo decks, the four candidate roof pieces adopted.

Proposed port order (biggest visual win first)

  1. Billboards, posters, signage M Sky named it. Every piece is adopted and none is placed: rules only (BB-1..4), the cheapest big change in every view.
  2. Sky track M Sky named it. Seen in nearly every aerial; one colour call, then the swept beam and kit pylons.
  3. Tram line M Sky named it. Rail tiles, sett bed and a parked car per line; routes unchanged.
  4. Rooftops M Half of every building at play zoom; theme plots and weights are a generator change.
  5. Palms and planting S–M Frontage greenery rule now; 10 m stagger after Sky's call.
  6. Street furniture and props M Café terraces, seaside and lane programmes; adopt the candidates.
  7. Skyline and horizon M–L Mid-ground CityMass ring in horizon.ts; Glint retunes the haze.
  8. Water, pier and aprons M Piles, quay steps, seaside kit.
  9. Landmarks and crowns M After Sky's size, site and form calls.
  10. Vehicles and aircars L Presentation in 075-D first; play traffic needs a sim decision.
  11. People L Presentation crowd in 075-D; play density is Pulse/Keel and Redline.
  12. Grade remainder S Haze distance, street probes (Glint).
  13. Road markings S Coral tactile pads only.

Buildings and streamline facades run alongside, already in progress (075-E). Each category lands with old / before / after on the flyby grid, the play-zoom compares and this scorecard updated; Redline costs each one. Everything is placed by generator rules from the plan, never by hand.

Questions for Sky

These are the categories that can't read right without a call (plan, cap or a reversed decision):

  1. Buildings and streamline facades: The height cap (Q1 in designs.md): the old canyon only outside the cap, streamline terraces inside it?
  2. Billboards, posters, signage: Do rooftop boards (6–8 m above the roof) count against the play-street height cap (16.8–20.4 m)? The old placed them on the low roofs exactly where the cap applies.
  3. Tram line: The old tram ran in the carriageway; ours runs in a lawn median on the Boulevard. Keep the median but pave the track bed in setts (no plan change), or a grass track (modern, reads less 1950s)?
  4. Sky track (sky rail): Sky rail colour: coral (GDD §01 "coral transit") or the old ivory with a stripe? Proposal: ivory beam with a coral stripe, so transit still reads coral.
  5. Palms and planting: Palms at 10 m staggered? It reverses the 2026-10-22 call for 12 m (crowns roof 60 % of the kerb line, not 50 %).
  6. Vehicles and aircars: Ambient traffic in play: wanted for this round (a sim change through Keel, replays exact), or presentation-only for now?
  7. Landmarks and crowns: Sphere size (×0.425 / ×0.56 / ×0.67)? The arch on Crown Avenue? The rocket gantry back (reverses brief 007 r2)? The old gold SpaceHQ form (reverses "atom, not rocket")? All in designs.md, Q2–Q4.
